content.text: •pain/discomfort in LUQ, left shoulder pain, &/or early satiety
•LUQ, left chest wall, or left shoulder pain that is worse w/ inspiration
•may be assoc w/ SOB and exertional Sx
•acute-onset, persistent upper abd pain radiating to the back
•epigastric pain or discomfort = the most prominent Sx
•postprandial fullness, early satiation, epigastric pain, or burning
•N/V, abd pain, early satiety, postprandial fullness, and bloating
•intense, dull discomfort located in the RUQ or epigastrium
•generally lasts ± 30 minutes, plateauing w.in one hr
•prolonged (>4 to 6 hrs) RUQ or epigastric pain, fever
•RUQ pain w fatigue, malaise, N/V, & anorexia
•may also have jaundice, dark urine, and light-colored stools
•RUQ pain w a pleuritic component, pain = sometimes referred to the Rt shoulder
•Sx incl fever, abd pain, abd distention (from ascites), LE edema, jaundice, GI bleed, &/or hepatic encephalopathy
•periumbilical pain initially that radiates to the RLQ
•LLQ pain USU constant & present for several days prior to presentation
•pain MC Sx, var from mild to severe
•generally flank pain, but may have back or abd pain
•Assoc w/ dysuria, freq, urgency, hematuria, fever, chills, flank pain, & CVA
•present w/ lower abd pain and discomfort; inability to urinate
•diarrhea as the predom Sx, but may also have assoc abd pain, which may be severe
